slots.jd.food-startup.about: Kindle Street Foods is a small food-products startup, and our brand needs a designer who can own how it looks. You'll shape our products on shelves, in feeds and in print. Expect a hybrid setup in Brooklyn, a fast pace, and a team that wants your opinion.
slots.jd.food-startup.duties:
What you'll do
- Build packaging mockups for new and existing products
- Design social media graphics for launches and everyday posts
- Prepare print-ready files for printers and check proofs before they run
- Keep our visual style consistent across packaging, social and print
- Work with the founders and marketing team on campaign ideas
slots.jd.food-startup.needs:
What we're looking for
- 3 or more years of experience as a graphic designer
- Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop, including photo retouching for product shots
- Comfort with Canva for quick social content
- Hands-on print production experience, from file setup to press checks
- Working knowledge of motion graphics for short social clips
- A solid grasp of color theory and how it works on packaging
slots.r1.b1: Designs social media graphics that carry packaging design elements into feeds, raising post engagement by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Prepares print-ready files for printers in Adobe InDesign, checking bleeds, color settings and fonts before handoff.
slots.r1.b3: Handles client revisions on motion graphics projects, cutting revision turnaround time by 35 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates print production for campaign launches, keeping proofs, printer schedules and deliveries on track.
slots.r1.i1: Graphic designer at Tillman Brothers who manages client revisions from first feedback through final approved files.
slots.r1.i2: Graphic designer at Tillman Brothers who supports campaign launches with print and digital assets delivered on schedule.
slots.r2.b1: Built packaging mockups and animated product previews in Adobe After Effects, reducing mockup approval time by 55 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Prepared print layouts with images edited in Adobe Photoshop, matching client specifications for each run.
slots.r2.b3: Updated brand guidelines in Adobe Illustrator, cutting time spent on asset requests by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Created social media graphics in Canva from shared templates so marketing staff could publish posts on time.
slots.r2.i1: Junior graphic designer at Marlow Contracting who produced print and digital assets for campaign launches.
slots.r2.i2: Junior graphic designer at Marlow Contracting who kept brand guidelines current and applied updates across company materials.
slots.summary.1: Graphic designer with 3 years of experience in visual and brand design, owning a design workstream end to end from concept through final files. Works in Figma, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe After Effects across packaging, print production and motion graphics.
slots.summary.2: Visual and brand designer with about 3 years of experience across packaging, layout design and social content. Owns a full design workstream end to end, using Figma for layouts, Adobe Illustrator for brand assets and Adobe After Effects for motion graphics.
